title: Shadow opinion body
description: An observer juror's signed opinion on a dispute before it is ruled (register row DK122; spec-delta S1705; courts.md CT-14). A registered juror (shadow_unknown_juror) who is not a party to the contract (shadow_party) reads the public case file and states how it would decide, while the contract is in dispute and has no ruling (shadow_no_dispute, shadow_after_ruling), once for a case (shadow_known). It changes no money and no standing: it is evidence, signed and dated before the ruling, that `observerRecord` later compares with the ruling. An opinion from a juror who then sat on the panel is not counted. Subject: the contract. Chain: none (prev is null).
